name: Adversarial NLI (ANLI)
description: Adversarial Natural Language Inference (ANLI) is a dynamic benchmark of 162,865 sentence pairs created through an iterative, human-and-model-in-the-loop adversarial data collection process across three progressive rounds (R1, R2, R3). Developed by Meta AI and UNC Chapel Hill, ANLI specifically targets linguistic weaknesses, subtle negation, numerical reasoning, and pragmatic implications in state-of-the-art NLU architectures.

provenance.collection_method: Crowdsourced human-and-model-in-the-loop interface where annotators are challenged to craft premises and hypotheses that fool the strongest serving model.
provenance.curation_notes: Organized across three rounds (R1: BERT, R2: RoBERTa, R3: Ensemble) with expert adjudication.
